  "reason": "The assistant contradicts the reference by providing incorrect and fabricated information about the costs of calling 'Die Dargebotene Hand'. The reference states the cost is CHF 0.20–0.70 per call, while the assistant claims costs vary by provider and region and provides specific euro amounts for German providers, which is factually inconsistent with the reference and likely incorrect.",
  "evidence": "Ils custs per telefonat tar il post da cussegliaziun 'Die Dargebotene Hand' varian segun il provider da telecommunicaziun e la regiun. Ils custs correspundan a quai d’ina conversaziun locala normala cun il prefix 0800. Per exempel, cun Vodafone en Germania custa ina conversaziun locala 0,14 € per minuta (tar tariffas da basa), cun T-Mobile 0,12 € per minuta, e cun E-Plus 0,10 € per minuta. Ils custs pon differenziar segun il provider e la tariffa specifica dal client."
